points: Your site shows 175,346 reviews, yet only 2 of 30 ads carry a proof number, and both repeat 231 years. Gift buyers skip brands they cannot check. Put 175,346 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription, so a repeat buyer has no reason to lock in. Run two retention ads with subscribe and save as the headline, aimed at families restocking games.
Creator posts run as brand ads

13 of 27 ads are creator posts with a code, #ad or @mention, run from your brand page. That borrowed trust fades on a brand account. Whitelist the rocket and doctor set posts from the creator account, then cut three variations.

Your 27 copy ads open with 18 different stories, so no single opener builds recognition. The biggest, get ahead this Christmas, leads only 3 ads. Pick the two best stories and build the next batch from them.
